answer.text: Creed Bratton is a character who works at Dunder-Mifflin, specifically in Quality Assurance. He is known for his quirky and sometimes mysterious behavior. In the show, Creed expresses a love for his various interests, saying, "Do I love being manager?… I love my kids. I love real estate. I love ceramics. I love my job. I-I love wrestling." He also has a tendency to make unusual statements, such as claiming that bankruptcy is "nature's do-over" and transferring his debt to William Charles Schneider when in trouble. Creed is portrayed as a somewhat eccentric and secretive individual, with a humorous and unpredictable personality.
